name: youtube-multi-source-research
description: Turn a topic, question, or URL into a timestamped, cited research brief across every relevant configured platform.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-platform research from topics and URLs
interface.longDescription: Automatically choose quick, standard, or deep research for a topic or URL, collect across every relevant configured source, show source coverage first, save the read-only cited brief locally, and report any local source setup still required.
interface.defaultPrompt: For an unqualified request such as 「リサーチして」「調査して」「調べて」, automatically use Universal Multi-Source Research without requiring the user to name it; choose research depth, investigate across YouTube, X, Reddit, ordinary Web, and other relevant configured sources, show source coverage first, include script-ready YouTube transcript materials, save the cited brief locally, and report any setup or blocker.
